# Synthetic demonstration fixtures

All 35 articles, 128 market bars, reviewed exposure assumptions and replay responses were authored for this functional prototype. No source scraping, actual model inference, real-market validation or predictive-quality claim. Original synthetic material may be redistributed with the project. URLs use example.invalid.

Demo IDs: syn-001 (earnings), syn-002 (crude supply disruption with conflicting equity and commodity evidence), syn-003 (order announcement). syn-004 is irrelevant; syn-005 uncertain; syn-031 duplicates syn-001; syn-032 is a unique same-company Asian Paints earnings update from 12 to 18 percent: source_version 2, predecessor syn-001, same source URL, publication 09:00 UTC and first seen 09:05 UTC after the original 08:00/08:05 UTC. Its replay filter and extraction use the exact revised source passage. At the noon cutoff event memory must classify it as update related to syn-001, not duplicate. All article publication/first-seen times precede Jan 12 noon UTC.

16 weekday sessions Jan 2?23, 2026; 9 after Jan 12 cutoff. These are synthetic session dates, not a verified exchange calendar. Equity and benchmark closes 10:00 UTC; commodity closes 11:00 UTC; availability five minutes later. One explicitly synthetic fixed crude contract, no roll. Universe is a demonstration assumption, not current listing/investability information.

Definitions and decisions: return 102/100-1 = .02; excess subtracts same-date benchmark return. Relative volume uses the previous five observed sessions, excluding current. Stale means latest close older than four calendar days. Multiple commodity contracts fail closed. No forward fill. Latest eligible exposure effective/known vintage supersedes old vintages; ties are ambiguous. Weights .6/.4, equity scale .02, commodity .03, threshold +/-.15, coverage .6; missing mandatory evidence abstains. Earnings/orders and equity-only ablation use equity weight 1. Narrative direction and volume never enter score. Outcomes are hypothetical long returns, independent of evidence sign, next observed session open through fifth observed session close, gross minus 10 bps total round-trip cost. Benchmark excess is gross equity minus gross benchmark. Outcome entry timestamps are NSE 09:15 Asia/Kolkata on the observed session date, normalized to UTC (03:45 UTC); exit timestamps are the fifth observed session close. Only supplied observed sessions are counted; there is no exchange-calendar completeness proof. A session whose open precedes the decision cannot be an entry. Known corporate actions in run snapshot invalidate outcomes; undetected actions cannot be inferred from OHLC alone. Missing benchmark remains explicit.

Fusion score divides the weighted component sum by the sum of VALID component weights; coverage divides valid weights by the total EXPECTED weights. Missing mandatory components still force abstention, even when the remaining score is large.

## Presentation additions (2026-11-21, demo-backend)

`synthetic_lab_history.csv`: 523 weekday bars, 2019-01-01 to 2020-12-31, for the single instrument `SYNTHETIC:LAB_DEMO`. It is an authored, seeded (PCG64 seed 20191231) zero-drift random walk, generated once and stored as a static file. It is not market data and carries no performance meaning. It exists only so the strategy lab (2020-capped history, backtest, Monte Carlo) has an offline fallback in the synthetic demo. `run_demo` imports it into the demo ledger. `configs/synthetic_lab.json` lists it, with `synthetic: true`, in the demo universe only, and the UI labels `SYNTHETIC:` series "interface verification only; not performance evidence". It is never an event-evidence company, never appears in the live universe, and never enters run features or technicals. The 2026 event-demo bars still never qualify for the lab.

`gold_labels.json`: hand-authored relevance, event_type, company_id and commodity_id for all 35 articles, read from the article text. One annotator, no agreement measured. Synthetic sanity check on authored articles, not a benchmark. It differs from the replay outputs on purpose where the text warrants: the "unconfirmed SpiceJet report without a clear financial event" items are gold `irrelevant` / `other`, while the replay filter returns `uncertain`. Replay outputs are identical for every policy, so replay agreement rows cannot show policy differences.

Demo story contrasts available without new data (cutoffs in UTC on 2026-01-12): `syn-002` at 12:00 gives equity +0.40 and crude leg −0.50 (crude +1.5% × reviewed exposure −1), so the score is 0.04, neutral, with a conflict. `syn-002` at 10:30, after the 10:00 equity close but before the 11:00 crude close, abstains because the commodity return for the same session is not yet available. `syn-001` gives positive 0.40. `syn-005` abstains (unsupported event family). `syn-004` is filtered as irrelevant.
